integrity: All-length counting is supported by explicit gap generating identities, a two-way fiber classification, and exhaustive disjoint counting. Enumeration is only corroboration. Literature-equivalence risk remains.
scientific_limitations: Binary linear words of known length and weight exactly two; all noiseless substring-composition multiplicities up to a known cutoff. Not a theorem about cyclic words, other weights, missing/noisy readings, or independent validation. Special full-length and r=2 cases overlap prior general settings.
title: A sharp \(3r-1\) saturation law for two-marker length-limited composition decks
